issue.title: Bug: sonic-cfggen returning some boolean values as True and False, breaking YANG validation

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

YANG mandates that boolean values are true and false, having the first letter be capital as is represented by Python would cause yang validation failures inside of libyang.

sonic-cfggen is sometimes outputting these values as True and False leading to YANG validation failures.

### Steps to Reproduce

This can be seen, for instance, when setting:
```
"MGMT_VRF_CONFIG": {
  "vrf_global": {
    "mgmtVrfEnabled": "true"
  }
}
```

Then running `config save -y`.  The written value is then "True", if then just running `config replace /etc/sonic/config_db.json` it would result in an error of:

```
Invalid value "True" in "mgmtVrfEnabled" element.
```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Should be output as "true" instead of "True" when writing the config.

resolution.title: config_db should not mandate True and False for featured
resolution.description:
YANG models mandate true and false are lowercase.  However featured takes "True" and "False" only.  This is a mismatch that causes issue for those using yang models.  There is no reason for these to be case sensitive.  Rewrite.

Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/22527
Signed-off-by: Brad House <<EMAIL>>
